title: A trip to Mars
text: Humans have walked on the Moon, but nobody has walked on Mars yet. Space agencies and companies are going to change that. Many experts think that the first astronauts are going to land on Mars in the next twenty years.

The trip is going to be very long. Mars is far away, so the journey is going to take about seven months. The astronauts are going to live in a small spaceship and eat special food. They are going to exercise every day, because in space muscles get weak.
Mars is not a friendly place. There is very little air and it is very cold: the average temperature is minus sixty degrees. There are also huge dust storms that can cover the whole planet.

To survive, the astronauts are going to need a base. They are going to make water from the ice under the ground and grow vegetables in special greenhouses. Some engineers want to build houses with a 3D printer, using red Martian dust.
Are you going to be one of the first people on Mars? Maybe! The first explorers of Mars are probably at school right now.

grammar.title: Grammar: going to
grammar.rule: Use be going to + verb for plans and for things that we are sure will happen.
items: The astronauts are going ___ on Mars.
The journey ___ going to be very long.
___ you going to be an astronaut?
I am going ___ a house with a 3D printer.
